rationale: Every strategy on the filter carries a condition and none is satisfied, so the value is left unchanged. This is the rule decided in philterd/phisql#57.
The unchanged value is not in the applied span list, the same convention as a span suppressed by an ignore rule.

Leaving it unchanged is what lets a condition narrow a strategy, such as TRUNCATE_TO_YEAR only where the token is a birthdate. A policy that must transform every detected value ends with an unconditional strategy.
The value that satisfies the condition takes its strategy; the value that satisfies none is left unchanged and is not an applied span (philterd/phisql#57).
Pins that the unchanged value does not fall back to the default redaction, as it would for a filter with no strategies at all.
